name: Afraid Fox 80
author: LilaRest
description: Rounded white button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #e8e8e8 to #eee, transform becomes scale(105%), starts the movingBorders animation (animating).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Afraid Fox 80</title>
<style>
/* Afraid Fox 80 by LilaRest — https://uiverse.io/LilaRest/afraid-fox-80 */
button {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 20px 25px 20px 22px;
  box-shadow: rgba(10, 37, 64, 0.35) 0px -2px 6px 0px inset;
  background-color: #e8e8e8;
  border-color: #ffe2e2;
  border-style: solid;
  border-width: 9px;
  border-radius: 35px;
  font-size: 25px;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: rgb(134, 124, 124);
  font-family: monospace;
  transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(.68,-0.55,.27,2.5),
  border-color 400ms ease-in-out,
  background-color 400ms ease-in-out;
  word-spacing: -2px;
}

@keyframes movingBorders {
  0% {
    border-color: #fce4e4;
  }

  50% {
    border-color: #ffd8d8;
  }

  90% {
    border-color: #fce4e4;
  }
}

button:hover {
  background-color: #eee;
  transform: scale(105%);
  animation: movingBorders 3s infinite;
}

button svg {
  fill: rgb(255, 110, 110);
  margin-right: 13px;
}

@keyframes beatingHeart {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }

  15% {
    transform: scale(1.15);
  }

  30% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }

  45% {
    transform: scale(1.15);
  }

  60% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

button:hover svg {
  animation: beatingHeart 1.2s infinite;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  <svg height="32" width="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M0 0H24V24H0z" fill="none"></path><path d="M16.5 3C19.538 3 22 5.5 22 9c0 7-7.5 11-10 12.5C9.5 20 2 16 2 9c0-3.5 2.5-6 5.5-6C9.36 3 11 4 12 5c1-1 2.64-2 4.5-2z"></path></svg>
  Like
</button>

</body>
</html>
